description: This file defines functions and types for generating, manipulating, and comparing ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) node snapshots, including rendering ARIA trees, matching templates, and detecting changes. It is part of a larger accessibility testing or snapshot system.

classes.name: AriaSnapshot
classes.description: Type representing a snapshot of ARIA nodes, elements, references, and iframe references.

classes.name: AriaRef
classes.description: Type representing a reference to an ARIA node with role, name, and ref string.

classes.name: AriaTreeOptions
classes.description: Options for generating ARIA trees, including mode and optional refPrefix.

classes.name: InternalOptions
classes.description: Internal configuration derived from AriaTreeOptions for processing.

methods.name: toInternalOptions
methods.description: Converts public AriaTreeOptions into internal configuration options.

methods.name: generateAriaTree
methods.description: Generates an ARIA snapshot tree from a root element based on specified options.

methods.name: computeAriaRef
methods.description: Computes and assigns a unique ARIA reference for a node based on options.

methods.name: toAriaNode
methods.description: Creates an ARIA node representation from an element, including role, name, and properties.

methods.name: normalizeGenericRoles
methods.description: Normalizes 'generic' roles in ARIA nodes, simplifying the hierarchy.

methods.name: normalizeStringChildren
methods.description: Normalizes string children within ARIA nodes, trimming whitespace and removing redundancies.

methods.name: matchesStringOrRegex
methods.description: Checks if a string matches a given string or regex pattern.

methods.name: matchesTextValue
methods.description: Checks if a text matches an ARIA text value pattern or normalized value.

methods.name: matchesExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Matches ARIA nodes against a template and returns the matching nodes and received data.

methods.name: getAllElementsMatchingExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Returns all elements matching a given ARIA template.

methods.name: matchesNode
methods.description: Checks if an ARIA node matches a given template.

methods.name: listEqual
methods.description: Checks if two lists of ARIA nodes or strings are equal.

methods.name: containsList
methods.description: Checks if a list of ARIA nodes or strings contains a given template list.

methods.name: matchesNodeDeep
methods.description: Recursively finds all ARIA nodes matching a template within a tree.

methods.name: buildByRefMap
methods.description: Builds a map of ARIA nodes keyed by their reference string.

methods.name: compareSnapshots
methods.description: Compares two ARIA snapshots and marks nodes as 'skip', 'same', or 'changed'.

methods.name: filterSnapshotDiff
methods.description: Filters ARIA nodes to include only changed parts based on a diff status map.

methods.name: renderAriaTree
methods.description: Renders an ARIA snapshot as a YAML-like string, optionally comparing with a previous snapshot for diffs.

methods.name: convertToBestGuessRegex
methods.description: Converts a string into a regex pattern with heuristics for dynamic content.

methods.name: textContributesInfo
methods.description: Determines if a text string contributes meaningful info for matching.

methods.name: ariaNodeElement
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element associated with an ARIA node.

methods.name: setAriaNodeElement
methods.description: Associates a DOM element with an ARIA node.

methods.name: findNewElement
methods.description: Finds a new DOM element corresponding to a changed ARIA node.
